name: Instrument: Build the recognition platform's configuration specification (gated on `86ajgn2z5`)
markdown_description:
I6. What a recognition is (an act, one service, a peer's words); the refused features (points, rewards, rankings, per-person counts, a manager's class, surveys, values tags, off-shift prompts, any export to a review); the language constant on every word and canon in full on the house-written parts; the brief's reading rule and the decline rule; the fallback fielded form on the backbone; confirmed item by item before the first training service; feeds row 135 and carries the count of recognitions read per period to the reset's environment reads. Refuses any feature not on the carries list. Lives on the platform, configuration or to confirm, with the partners' page for what is manual; owned by the Maitre d for the refusals and the Operations Lead for the configuration, confirmed at the reset. High. Gated on `86ajgn2z5`, canon's ruling on S10 finding 20.10 for the peer's-words line, and `86akht376` for the reward refusal.

Filed by Session 11 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task `86ajgmj7c`. Reasoning lives on the S11 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc `2ky45bmy-17253`.
